description: A FastAPI router module implementing CRUD operations for managing user favorites, specifically allowing listing, adding, and removing favorite recipes for a mock user.

methods.name: bool _recipe_exists(recipe_id: int)
methods.description: Helper function to check if a recipe with a given ID exists in the RECIPES list.

methods.name: list_favorites(user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id"))
methods.description: Endpoint to list favorite recipes for a user.

methods.name: add_favorite(payload: FavoriteCreateRequest, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id"))
methods.description: Endpoint to add a recipe to user's favorites.

methods.name: remove_favorite(recipe_id: int, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id"))
methods.description: Endpoint to remove a recipe from user's favorites.

ctags.name: add_favorite
ctags.pattern: /^def add_favorite(payload: FavoriteCreateRequest, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description=/
ctags.signature: (payload: FavoriteCreateRequest, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id"))

ctags.name: list_favorites
ctags.pattern: /^def list_favorites(user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id")):$/

ctags.name: remove_favorite
ctags.pattern: /^def remove_favorite(recipe_id: int, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id/
ctags.signature: (recipe_id: int, user_id: str = Query(MOCK_USER_ID, description="Mock user id"))
